description: A Python script that converts a list of strings into a C++ byte array representing a Deterministic Acyclic Finite State Automaton (DAFSA). It parses gperf files, constructs and compresses the graph, and generates C++ code for efficient string matching, specifically for domain name processing.

methods.name: to_dafsa
methods.description: Generates a DAFSA from a list of words, creating nodes for each character.

methods.name: to_words
methods.description: Reconstructs words from a DAFSA starting from internal nodes.

methods.name: reverse
methods.description: Reverses the DAFSA, making sink nodes into sources.

methods.name: join_labels
methods.description: Merges internal nodes with single children to optimize the graph.

methods.name: join_suffixes
methods.description: Merges nodes with identical suffixes towards the sink.

methods.name: top_sort
methods.description: Performs a topological sort of the DAFSA nodes.

methods.name: encode_links
methods.description: Encodes child node links as 1-3 byte offsets.

methods.name: encode_prefix
methods.description: Encodes a label as a reversed list of bytes without a high byte.

methods.name: encode_label
methods.description: Encodes a label with a trailing high byte indicating end.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes the entire DAFSA into a byte array.

methods.name: to_cxx
methods.description: Generates C++ code defining the byte array.

methods.name: words_to_cxx
methods.description: Converts a list of words into C++ byte array code.

methods.name: parse_gperf
methods.description: Parses a gperf file to extract strings and return codes.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to parse arguments, process input, and generate C++ code.
